arxiv-2109-04702.title: Projection predictive inference beyond Exponential Family models
arxiv-2109-04702.creator: Alejandro Catalina
arxiv-2109-04702.description: Abstract Given a reference model that includes all the available variables, projection predictive inference replaces its posterior with a constrained projection including only a subset of all variables. We extend projection predictive inference to enable computationally efficient variable and structure selection in models outside the exponential family.

arxiv-2109-07871.title: Resolution based Feature Distillation for Cross Resolution Person Re-Identification
arxiv-2109-07871.creator: Asad Munir, Chengjin Lyu, Bart Goossens, Wilfried Philips, Christian Micheloni
arxiv-2109-07871.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Asad Munir, Chengjin Lyu, Bart Goossens, Wilfried Philips, Christian Micheloni. Person re-identification (re-id) aims to retrieve images of same identities across different camera views. Resolution mismatch occurs due to varying distances between person of interest and cameras, this significantly degrades the performance of re-id in real world scenarios. Most of the existing approaches resolve the re-id task as low resolution problem in which a low resolution query image is searched in a high resolution images gallery.

arxiv-2110-12505.title: Quantitative absorption imaging of optically dense effective two-level systems
arxiv-2110-12505.creator: R. Veyron, V. Mancois, J-B. Gerent, G. Baclet, P. Bouyer, S. Bernon
arxiv-2110-12505.description: Abstract Absorption imaging is a commonly adopted method to acquire, with high temporal resolution, spatial information on a partially transparent object. It relies on the interference between a probe beam and the coherent response of the object. In the low saturation regime, it is well described by a Beer Lambert attenuation.

arxiv-2110-15399.title: Spontaneous formation of time-periodic vortex cluster in nonlinear fluids of light
arxiv-2110-15399.creator: Kirill A. Sitnik, Sergey Alyatkin, Julian D. Töpfer, Ivan Gnusov, Tamsin Cookson, Helgi Sigurdsson, Pavlos G. Lagoudakis
arxiv-2110-15399.description: Abstract We demonstrate spontaneous formation of a nonlinear vortex cluster state in a microcavity exciton-polariton condensate with time-periodic sign flipping of its topological charges at the GHz scale. When optically pumped with a ring-shaped nonresonant laser, the trapped condensate experiences intricate high-order mode competition and fractures into two distinct trap levels.

Photons in the zenith angle range from 30 ∘ to 60 ∘ can be identified in the overwhelming background of showers initiated by charged cosmic rays through the broader time structure of the signals induced in the water-Cherenkov detectors of the array and the steeper lateral distribution of shower particles reaching ground.

Human activities, such as dredging and dumping operations, can disrupt turbidity levels and should be monitored and analyzed for possible effects. arxiv-2309-04300.title: Trapped Imbalanced Quantum Droplets
arxiv-2309-04300.creator: T. A. Flynn, N. A. Keepfer, N. G. Parker, T. P. Billam
arxiv-2309-04300.description: Abstract A two-component quantum droplet is an attractive mixture of ultracold bosons stabilised against collapse by quantum fluctuations. Commonly, two-component quantum droplets are studied within a balanced mixture. However, the mixture can be imbalanced resulting in a lower energy but less stably bound droplet, or even a droplet submerged in a gas.

arxiv-2402-17245.title: Playground v2.5: Three Insights towards Enhancing Aesthetic Quality in Text-to-Image Generation
arxiv-2402-17245.creator: Daiqing Li, Aleks Kamko, Ehsan Akhgari, Ali Sabet, Linmiao Xu, Suhail Doshi
arxiv-2402-17245.description: Abstract In this work, we share three insights for achieving state-of-the-art aesthetic quality in text-to-image generative models. We focus on three critical aspects for model improvement: enhancing color and contrast, improving generation across multiple aspect ratios, and improving human-centric fine details.

arxiv-2406-09350.title: Quantum statistics in the minimal scenario
arxiv-2406-09350.creator: Victor Barizien, Jean-Daniel Bancal
arxiv-2406-09350.description: Abstract In any given experimental scenario, the rules of quantum theory provide statistical distributions that the observed outcomes are expected to follow. The set formed by all these distributions contains the imprint of quantum theory, capturing some of its core properties. So far, only partial descriptions have been known for this set, even in the simplest scenarios.

pmc-13534569.title: 系统性红斑狼疮继发真菌感染影响因素分析
pmc-13534569.creator: Chunlin Li, Qiuyu Fan, Yu Xiao, Ting Song, Ziye Zong, Wei Yang
pmc-13534569.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 目的探讨系统性红斑狼疮（systemic lupus erythematosus，SLE）患者继发真菌感染的影响因素。方法回顾性选取2021年6月—2025年1月我院收治的310例SLE患者作为研究对象，根据有无继发真菌感染分为未感染组和感染组，经倾向性评分法（propensity score matching，PSM）进行5：1匹配后，未感染组和感染组分别纳入患者230例、46例。分析SLE患者继发真菌感染现状，通过Logistic回归分析SLE患者继发真菌感染的影响因素，并采用受试者工作特征（receiver operating characteristic，ROC）曲线评估模型预测效能，构建预测SLE患者继发真菌感染的列线图模型。结果在纳入的310例SLE患者中真菌感染46例（14.84%），以肺部感染（50.0%）和胃肠道感染（23.9%）为主。匹配分组后，二元Logistic回归分析结果显示，狼疮活动度（OR=10.734，95%CI=2.015～57.184）、抗菌药物应用时间（OR=13.826，95%CI=2.995～63.822）、CRP（OR=9.927，95%CI=1.024～96.188）、白细胞计数（OR=11.784，95%CI=1.568～88.553）、补体C4（OR=16.392，95%CI=3.899～68.909）、24 h Pro（OR=9.391，95%CI=1.195～73.813）均为SLE患者继发真菌感染的独立危险因素（P<0.05）。ROC曲线评估显示，狼疮活动度、抗菌药物应用时间、C反应蛋白、白细胞计数、补体C4、24 h尿蛋白对SLE患者继发真菌感染均有一定的预测能力，六者联合预测的曲线下面积（area under the curve，AUC）为0.821，95%CI为0.720～0.922，优于单一指标（AUC 0.593~0.672）。此六者联合纳入构建列线图模型。结论狼疮活动度、抗菌药物应用时间、CRP、WBC、补体C4、24 h Pro是SLE患者继发真菌感染的影响因素。Keywords: 系统性红斑狼疮, 真菌感染, 影响因素, 倾向性评分法 系统性红斑狼疮（systemic lupus erythematosus, SLE）属于累及全身多脏器的慢性自身免疫病，最新流行病学调查报告显示[1]，SLE的全球患病率约为30/10万～150/10万，年发病率约2.2/10万～23.1/10万，我国发病率为30.13/10万～70.41/10万左右，且高发于育龄期女性群体。 在SLE的临床管理实践中，伴随着疾病治疗手段的不断发展与广泛应用，一系列新的临床问题也逐渐显现出来。具体而言，由于糖皮质激素在临床中长期应用、广谱抗菌药物广泛使用以及免疫抑制剂对机体免疫功能的损害，复杂感染已成为影响SLE预后的关键因素；其中真菌感染因其起病隐匿、诊断困难、治疗棘手等特点，更是当前危重症患者死亡的主要诱因之一[2]。真菌感染不仅可诱发并加剧SLE，更贯穿疾病全程[3]；相关研究表明[4]，近5年真菌感染发生率已达20世纪90年代的2倍，且发病率持续攀升，显著增加了临床诊疗难度和患者死亡风险，应引起临床的高度重视。鉴于上述严峻形势，预防SLE患者继发真菌感染已成为临床防控重点，而要实现有效的预防，早期识别相关危险因素是制定精准防治策略的关键前提。 倾向性评分法（propensity score matching, PSM）是对观察研究中偏差问题进行处理的一种统计学方法，目的是对随机分配效果进行模拟，减少非随机分配所引起的选择偏差，提高因果推断的准确性[5]。本研究即根据PSM采用单因素和多因素Logistic回归模型探究SLE患者继发真菌感染的影响因素，并建立风险预测模型，为临床早期防治提供科学参考。 资料与方法 样本量和分组 本研究为回顾性研究，经武汉市中西医结合医院伦理委员会批准，伦理批号：科伦预审[2024]54号，严格遵循《赫尔辛基宣言》伦理准则。 参考文献[6]计算样本量，采用统计学标准公式：N=Z2×[P(1－P)]/E2，其中各参数定义为：N代表所需最小样本量，Z对应标准正态分布临界值，P表示预期总体率，E为允许的最大抽样误差范围，该公式通过控制Ⅰ类错误概率和估计精度，确保研究具有足够的统计检验效能，当置信度为95%时，Z=1.96，P=0.2，E=5%，向上取整N为246例，即最低需纳入246例患者，考虑到10%～20%样本脱落率，最低需纳入296例患者。 本研究选取2021年6月—2025年1月我院收治的310例SLE患者作为研究对象，根据有无继发真菌感染，将研究对象分为未感染组264例和感染组46例。采用PSM对两组患者进行5∶1匹配，卡钳值为0.02。协变量包括性别、年龄、身体质量指数（body mass index，BMI）、吸烟、饮酒。匹配完成后，通过统计学方法验证协变量的均衡性，P>0.05即为分布均衡。最终未感染组和感染组分别纳入患者230例、46例。匹配前，未感染组与感染组在性别、年龄方面差异有统计学意义（P<0.05）。匹配后，两组基线资料均衡（P>0.05），见表1。 表 1Comparison of baseline data before and after pmc-13710424.description: SummaryActivin A, which promotes osteoclast differentiation, increases with declining kidney function, but its role in bone metabolism in kidney failure remains unclear.
